sources.entry: TriliumNext Notes - Cross-platform hierarchical note taking application with focus on building large personal knowledge bases (fork of Trilium Notes). AGPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker/K8S

summary.one_liner: TriliumNext/Trilium is a free, open-source, cross-platform hierarchical note-taking application for building large personal knowledge bases, forked from Trilium Notes.
summary.what_it_does: Organizes notes into an arbitrarily deep tree, where a single note can be cloned into multiple places. It offers a WYSIWYG text editor with tables, images, and math, plus source-code editing with syntax highlighting. Other note types include Excalidraw-based canvas sketches, mind maps, geo maps with GPX tracks, and relation/link maps. It provides full-text search, note versioning, per-note encryption, note attributes for querying and scripting, and a REST API. It can run as a desktop app or as a server accessed through a browser, with sync to a self-hosted sync server.
use_cases: publishing notes to the public internet
importing notes from Evernote or Markdown
notable: Note cloning lets one note appear in multiple places in the tree
Built-in note types for canvas sketches, mind maps, geo maps, and Mermaid diagrams
Direct OpenID and TOTP login integration
Migrates existing zadam/Trilium databases without special steps (up to v0.90.4 is sync-compatible)
Per-note encryption and sharing notes publicly
caveats: Mobile use relies on the browser or third-party apps (TriliumDroid, Pocket Trilium, Trinote); the README says there is no official native mobile app
Browser support is limited to the latest Chrome and Firefox versions, per the README
Sync version must match across Trilium and TriliumDroid, so automatic server updates should be disabled when using TriliumDroid
keywords: organize my notes in a tree
